trial_court: VI Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, M.C. No.40/2013
case_name: Sri N Prasad vs Smt G Bharathi
facts_of_case: The parties were married on 29.4.1984. The husband/appellant is challenging the judgment and decree dismissing his petition seeking dissolution of marriage under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking dissolution of marriage to prove that the other party has deserted him.
legal_principles.held: It is stated by the wife that there is no desertion on her part and no ground is made out to grant a decree for dissolution of marriage either on the ground of cruelty or desertion.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not grant a decree for dissolution of marriage unless the party seeking it proves that the other party has deserted him.
legal_principles.held: No case is made out to grant a decree of dissolution of marriage and accordingly dismissed the petition.

outcome.final_order: The Family Court's judgment and decree dismissing the husband's petition was upheld.

keywords: Latin Maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
